kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_scrape_collector_duration_seconds IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_scrape_collector_duration_seconds = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_scrape_collector_duration_seconds)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.collector
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_scrape_collector_success IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_textfile_scrape_error IS NOT NULL
| STATS Scrape_success = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_scrape_collector_success)), node_textfile_scrape_error_B = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_textfile_scrape_error)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.collector
| EVAL Scrape_textfile_error_1_true = (-1 * node_textfile_scrape_error_B)
| DROP node_textfile_scrape_error_B
| SORT time_bucket ASC
